lines.zh: 脂鲤成群穿过树根，一条接一条
lines.en: We thread the roots one after another.

lines.zh: 水下洞穴很暗，脂鲤贴着石壁走
lines.en: The cave is dark; I skim the stone wall.

lines.zh: 红树林的水浑，脂鲤靠队形认路
lines.en: Mangrove water is murky; I follow the school.

lines.zh: 沼泽里水草多，脂鲤从缝里钻
lines.en: The swamp is weedy and I squeeze through gaps.

lines.zh: 脂鲤很小，一摆尾就换个位置
lines.en: Being tiny, one tail flick moves me anywhere.

lines.zh: 三条脂鲤并排，像一串小珠子
lines.en: Three of us abreast, like a string of beads.

lines.zh: 丛林水域漂着落叶，脂鲤绕开
lines.en: Leaves drift in the jungle water; I dodge them.

lines.zh: 洞顶滴下一滴水，脂鲤惊得窜出去
lines.en: A drip from the cave roof sends me darting.

lines.zh: 水流一变，整群脂鲤同时转向
lines.en: The current shifts and the school turns as one.

lines.zh: 脂鲤从树根底下钻过去，很熟练
lines.en: I slip under the roots like it's nothing.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥味重，脂鲤照样游得欢
lines.en: The swamp smells of mud and I swim gladly.

lines.zh: 脂鲤贴着同伴的侧线走，省力气
lines.en: I ride my neighbor's wake to save effort.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处有回声，脂鲤跟着游
lines.en: There's an echo deep in the cave; I follow it.

lines.zh: 一小群脂鲤掠过水面，像雨点
lines.en: A small school skims the surface like raindrops.

lines.zh: 我跟着前面那条的尾鳍。
lines.en: I follow the tail ahead of me.

lines.zh: 绕过一截断根，队形没散。
lines.en: Around a broken root, still in line.

lines.zh: 水一浑，我就靠同伴的侧影。
lines.en: When it muddies, I steer by my neighbor.

lines.zh: 我游在中间，最安全。
lines.en: I swim in the middle, safest there.

lines.zh: 石缝很窄，我侧着身过去。
lines.en: The gap is narrow; I turn sideways.

lines.zh: 我从一片水草穿到另一片。
lines.en: I slip from one weed bed to the next.

lines.zh: 脂鲤悬在树根间，随水轻晃
lines.en: I hover among roots, swaying with the water.

lines.zh: 洞穴里没有光，脂鲤也不着急
lines.en: No light in the cave, and I don't mind.

lines.zh: 脂鲤停在水草叶上，歇一会儿
lines.en: I rest a moment on a weed leaf.

lines.zh: 沼泽很安静，只有虫声从上头来
lines.en: The swamp is quiet but for insects above.

lines.zh: 同伴在旁，脂鲤就不必警戒
lines.en: With the school nearby I needn't stay alert.

lines.zh: 脂鲤张合着嘴，其实在滤水
lines.en: My mouth opens and closes, filtering water.

lines.zh: 红树林的影子在水里晃，脂鲤看着
lines.en: Mangrove shadows sway and I watch.

lines.zh: 脂鲤太小，一片落叶就是屋顶
lines.en: I'm so small a fallen leaf is a roof.

lines.zh: 洞里水凉，脂鲤挤在同伴中间
lines.en: Cave water is cold, so I press in among the school.

lines.zh: 脂鲤打个转，又回到原位
lines.en: I spin once and settle back where I was.

lines.zh: 丛林的水带点木头味，脂鲤习惯
lines.en: Jungle water tastes of wood; I'm used to it.

lines.zh: 脂鲤静静悬着，鳍几乎不动
lines.en: I hang still, fins barely moving.

lines.zh: 水面透下一点光斑，脂鲤凑过去
lines.en: A fleck of light comes down and I drift to it.

lines.zh: 一群脂鲤停在原地，像撒了把沙
lines.en: The school halts, like scattered grains of sand.

lines.zh: 脂鲤从树根后探头看你
lines.en: I peek at you from behind a root.

lines.zh: 你蹚进沼泽，脂鲤全都散开
lines.en: You wade into the swamp and we scatter.

lines.zh: 脂鲤很小，你的影子对它太大
lines.en: I'm tiny; your shadow is enormous to me.

lines.zh: 脂鲤绕着你转，好奇又有点怕
lines.en: I circle you, curious and afraid.

lines.zh: 你手里的网，脂鲤认得
lines.en: I recognize the net in your hand.

lines.zh: 脂鲤躲在同伴后面偷看
lines.en: I hide behind a schoolmate and peek.

lines.zh: 你蹲在红树边，脂鲤游近一寸
lines.en: You crouch by the mangrove and I edge closer.

lines.zh: 脂鲤歪着身子，把你打量一遍
lines.en: I tilt and size you up.

lines.zh: 你不动，脂鲤就当你是块木头
lines.en: If you stay still, I'll take you for a log.

lines.zh: 一双双小眼睛在暗处看你
lines.en: Pairs of tiny eyes watch you from the dark.

lines.zh: 脂鲤被拍得晕头转向
lines.en: One swat and I'm reeling.

lines.zh: 这么小的鱼也下得去手
lines.en: You'd hit a fish this small?

lines.zh: 脂鲤躲进树根，气都不敢出
lines.en: I hide in the roots, not daring to breathe.

lines.zh: 三点血，一下就没了半条命
lines.en: Three hearts, and half are gone at once.

lines.zh: 血丝在水里散开，同伴跑了
lines.en: Blood threads the water and the school flees.

lines.zh: 脂鲤翻了身，勉强正过来
lines.en: Flipped over, I barely right myself.

lines.zh: 伤口在侧面，游起来歪
lines.en: The wound is on my flank and I swim crooked.

lines.zh: 脂鲤疼得乱窜，撞了石壁
lines.en: I dart in pain and hit the stone.

lines.zh: 这一下脂鲤记住了
lines.en: I'll remember that blow.

lines.zh: 脂鲤只剩一口气，还悬着
lines.en: Down to my last breath, I still hover.

lines.zh: 水里有碎屑落下，脂鲤立刻围上
lines.en: Scraps fall in the water and we crowd in.

lines.zh: 你把饵撒开，脂鲤抢成一团
lines.en: You scatter bait and we fight over it.

lines.zh: 一点点就够，脂鲤肚子很小
lines.en: A little is plenty; my belly is tiny.

lines.zh: 脂鲤闻到味道，队形全乱了
lines.en: The scent hits and our formation dissolves.

lines.zh: 那是吃的吗，脂鲤先尝一口
lines.en: Is it food? I'll taste a bit first.

lines.zh: 同伴抢到了，脂鲤赶紧挤进去
lines.en: A schoolmate got some; I push in.

lines.zh: 沼泽里少见这么好的东西
lines.en: Such good food is rare in the swamp.

lines.zh: 脂鲤围着饵转，不敢先动
lines.en: We circle the bait, none daring first.

lines.zh: 再撒一把，脂鲤就跟着你走
lines.en: One more handful and we'll follow you.

lines.zh: 脂鲤吃饱了，队形又回来了
lines.en: Fed, our school re-forms.

lines.zh: 脂鲤被撞得翻了半圈
lines.en: I tumble half around from the bump.

lines.zh: 这么小的鱼也撞，太不讲理
lines.en: Bumping something this small is rude.

lines.zh: 同伴挤过来，脂鲤让开一条缝
lines.en: A schoolmate pushes in and I make a gap.

lines.zh: 你蹚水一脚，脂鲤散了又聚
lines.en: Your step scatters us; we regroup.

lines.zh: 脂鲤贴着你的脚踝滑过去
lines.en: I slip past your ankle.

lines.zh: 树根太密，脂鲤撞了好几下
lines.en: The roots are dense and I bump them repeatedly.

lines.zh: 一群脂鲤撞成一团，像水花
lines.en: The school knots up like a splash.

lines.zh: 脂鲤被水流推得撞上石壁
lines.en: The current slams me into the cave wall.

lines.zh: 别挤，脂鲤才这么点大
lines.en: Don't crowd; I'm this small.

lines.zh: 脂鲤从你腿边绕开，很快
lines.en: I whip around your leg, quick.

lines.zh: 这一撞，鳞片都乱了
lines.en: That bump left my scales ruffled.

lines.zh: 脂鲤退回去，重新排好队
lines.en: I fall back and line up again.

lines.zh: 脂鲤游到同伴身侧，鳍碰鳍
lines.en: I sidle up to a schoolmate, fin to fin.

lines.zh: 沼泽的浅水处最适合产卵
lines.en: The swamp's shallows are best for eggs.

lines.zh: 两条脂鲤绕着水草转，很轻快
lines.en: Two of us circle the weeds, light and quick.

lines.zh: 水色变深时，脂鲤就成对了
lines.en: As the water darkens, we pair off.

lines.zh: 脂鲤把卵藏进树根的缝隙
lines.en: I tuck eggs into a gap between roots.

lines.zh: 同伴挑了半天，脂鲤就等着
lines.en: My mate takes ages choosing and I wait.

lines.zh: 一群脂鲤同时散开，各找各的
lines.en: The school breaks apart, each to a partner.

lines.zh: 脂鲤贴着对方游，像照镜子
lines.en: I swim beside my mate like a mirror.

lines.zh: 洞里回声把求偶声放大了
lines.en: The cave echo magnifies my courtship.

lines.zh: 脂鲤答应得很干脆
lines.en: I say yes without hesitation.

lines.zh: 脂鲤叼起一小片叶子
lines.en: I carry off a scrap of leaf.

lines.zh: 沉底的碎屑，脂鲤全收了
lines.en: Whatever sinks, I collect.

lines.zh: 脂鲤嘴里塞着东西，还想要
lines.en: My mouth is full and I want more.

lines.zh: 一颗小石子，脂鲤觉得稀罕
lines.en: A pebble strikes me as a treasure.

lines.zh: 掉进水里的果子屑，脂鲤先到
lines.en: Fruit crumbs fall in and I arrive first.

lines.zh: 脂鲤把卵石推到窝边
lines.en: I push a pebble toward my nest.

lines.zh: 同伴掉的食，脂鲤捡了
lines.en: A schoolmate dropped food and I took it.

lines.zh: 脂鲤衔着东西游不快
lines.en: Carrying things slows me down.

lines.zh: 洞穴里捡到的东西，脂鲤藏着
lines.en: Cave finds go into my hiding spot.

lines.zh: 别伸手，脂鲤嘴里有东西
lines.en: Don't reach in; my mouth is occupied.

lines.zh: 水面落下一只小虫，脂鲤盯住
lines.en: A bug lands on the surface and I fix on it.

lines.zh: 脂鲤看准了那一点碎屑
lines.en: I've picked out that crumb.

lines.zh: 目标很小，脂鲤比它还小
lines.en: The target is small; I'm smaller.

lines.zh: 同伴都往上冲，脂鲤跟上
lines.en: The school surges up and I follow.

lines.zh: 脂鲤转个身，瞄准水面
lines.en: I turn and aim at the surface.

lines.zh: 洞顶掉下东西，脂鲤先看见
lines.en: Something drops from the roof; I see it first.

lines.zh: 那点影子是吃的，脂鲤确定
lines.en: That speck is food; I'm certain.

lines.zh: 脂鲤锁定目标，鳍抖了抖
lines.en: Locked on, my fins quiver.

lines.zh: 沼泽里吃的不多，得抢
lines.en: Food is scarce in the swamp; I must race.

lines.zh: 脂鲤认定那只虫，别的不管
lines.en: I've chosen that bug and ignore the rest.

lines.zh: 脂鲤冲上水面，一口吞下
lines.en: I shoot to the surface and gulp it down.

lines.zh: 目标下沉，脂鲤追着往下
lines.en: The target sinks and I chase it down.

lines.zh: 同伴先到，脂鲤抢剩下的
lines.en: A schoolmate got there first; I take the rest.

lines.zh: 脂鲤钻过树根追，差点卡住
lines.en: I chase through the roots and nearly stick.

lines.zh: 虫在水面打转，脂鲤跟着转
lines.en: The bug spins on the surface and I spin too.

lines.zh: 追上去了，脂鲤离目标一尾巴
lines.en: Nearly there, one tail-length away.

lines.zh: 目标钻进草里，脂鲤找不到
lines.en: The target hides in weeds and I lose it.

lines.zh: 脂鲤追得急，撞上同伴
lines.en: Racing after it, I bump a schoolmate.

lines.zh: 一口咬空，脂鲤转回来再试
lines.en: I miss and turn back to try again.

lines.zh: 追到手了，脂鲤赶紧游开
lines.en: Got it; I hurry away with the prize.

lines.zh: 脂鲤冲上去咬，牙小得可怜
lines.en: I charge and bite with pitiful little teeth.

lines.zh: 这一口连皮都咬不破
lines.en: This bite wouldn't break skin.

lines.zh: 脂鲤撞了一下，对方没感觉
lines.en: I bump it and it doesn't even notice.

lines.zh: 一群围上去，靠数量吓人
lines.en: We swarm it, hoping numbers impress.

lines.zh: 脂鲤咬住不放，其实是咬着草
lines.en: I hold on tight, though it's just weed.

lines.zh: 对方一摆尾，脂鲤被甩开
lines.en: One flick of its tail throws me off.

lines.zh: 打不过就跑，脂鲤很懂
lines.en: Can't win, so run; I know the rule.

lines.zh: 脂鲤装凶，把鳍炸开
lines.en: I puff my fins up and act fierce.

lines.zh: 这一撞，脂鲤自己先晕了
lines.en: The hit leaves me dizzy instead.

lines.zh: 别笑，脂鲤已经很努力了
lines.en: Don't laugh; I'm doing my best.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处多了几点微光
lines.en: A few faint sparks appear deep in the cave.

lines.zh: 这窝三只，脂鲤挤在一起
lines.en: Three this spawn, pressed together.

lines.zh: 红树林的水一晃，脂鲤来了
lines.en: The mangrove water stirs and here we are.

lines.zh: 脂鲤出生在沼泽，水有点浑
lines.en: Born in the swamp, in water none too clear.

lines.zh: 一窝脂鲤同时散开找路
lines.en: The new school spreads out to find a path.

lines.zh: 丛林水域多了几条细影
lines.en: The jungle water gains a few slim shadows.

lines.zh: 脂鲤刚生成，还不认得洞
lines.en: Just spawned, I don't know the cave yet.

lines.zh: 水流带着脂鲤进了树根丛
lines.en: The current carries us into the roots.

lines.zh: 脂鲤睁眼，同伴就在旁边
lines.en: I open my eyes and my school is right there.

lines.zh: 第五条水路的家，我记住了
lines.en: Home on the fifth waterway; I'll remember it.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水烫起来，脂鲤往深处钻
lines.en: The swamp water heats and I dive deep.

lines.zh: 被甩到泥上，脂鲤弹了弹
lines.en: Thrown onto mud, I bounce a little.

lines.zh: 离开水，脂鲤的鳃一动不动
lines.en: Out of water my gills go still.

lines.zh: 冲击把水搅成一片白
lines.en: The blast turns the water white.

lines.zh: 箭擦过，脂鲤的鳞掉了一片
lines.en: An arrow grazes me and a scale comes off.

lines.zh: 药水的味道让脂鲤发懵
lines.en: The potion's reek leaves me dazed.

lines.zh: 沼泽没吃的，脂鲤瘦成一条线
lines.en: Nothing to eat in the swamp; I'm a thin line.

lines.zh: 雷打进沼泽，脂鲤全散了
lines.en: Lightning hits the swamp and the school scatters.

lines.zh: 水面没了，脂鲤一直往下坠
lines.en: The water's gone and I keep falling.
